pr.title: Make Codex execute TP lifecycle end-to-end by default
pr.body:
## Summary
- Update durable repo guidance so non-trivial Codex repo-changing work creates and executes a Task Packet end-to-end.
- Preserve Dopemux authority boundaries, truth hierarchy, PAL discipline, proof standards, and UNKNOWN handling.
- Add the governing TP and register it in the task-packet index.

## Validation
- JSON parse and manual schema checks for the TP.
- AGENTS.md instruction sanity checks.
- git diff --check.

## Residual risks / UNKNOWNs
- origin/main does not contain a tracked dopetask-canonical-spec.json; schema validation uses the schema inspected in the dirty primary checkout when available, otherwise manual schema checks.
- Agent runtime authority remains UNKNOWN across multiple agent families.

Future non-trivial repo-changing work should be TP-created and executed by Codex end-to-end, not answered as a standalone TP dump.

requirements: Inspect primary checkout identity, remotes, branch, status, and repo markers.
Read present authority files and preserve UNKNOWN where tracked base branch lacks uploaded authority artifacts.
validation: Repo identity is dopemux-mvp with origin https://github.com/DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp.git.

commands: manual schema check using declared root and nested fields
validation: Every step has id, task, and non-empty validation.

requirements: Update AGENTS.md only for durable Codex/agent execution guidance.
Do not modify production code, schemas, dependency files, or generated assembled files.
Preserve architecture boundaries and truth hierarchy.
validation: AGENTS.md states Codex must not stop at a standalone TP for non-trivial repo-changing work.
AGENTS.md includes preflight, worktree, TP validation, slice validation, review, precommit, commit, push, PR, proof, and cleanup closeout.
AGENTS.md preserves PM, memory, retrieval, bridge, ADHD, and repo-truth boundaries.

requirements: Inspect config/instructions/agents.instructions.md and clearly active repo-local agent instructions.
Update only if proven to govern Codex or repo-wide agent behavior.
Leave unproven surfaces untouched and record UNKNOWN.
validation: config/instructions/agents.instructions.md is not changed unless proven active for this Codex behavior.
AGENTS.md records UNKNOWN for unresolved agent runtime authority.

steps.task: Review, commit, push, PR, proof, cleanup.
requirements: Inspect git diff --stat and full git diff.
Run targeted validation and git diff --check.
Commit only allowlisted files, push branch, open PR when authenticated, emit proof, and remove worktree when safe after PR creation.
validation: Codereview confirms no architecture boundary collapse, no standalone-TP default remains, and TP lifecycle closeout is explicit.
Precommit-equivalent gate confirms validations passed, no forbidden files changed, no secrets exposed, and no generated noise committed.
PR URL or exact blocker is reported.
